conditional_physical_conversion.scope: Conditional conversion using the existing supplied Lambda ruler. The selected shell mass includes ambient material; no galaxy mass or size was fitted.

finite_formation_assessment.mass_definition: Fixed integral of the oscillatory scalar density in the envelope, in geometric units; excludes vacuum volume mass and higher-order GR gradient terms.
finite_formation_assessment.limits: Finite regular concentration and rebound for a separately supplied 10% seed; not an amplitude threshold, asymptotic bound state or exact full-GR evolution.

limits: Earlier homogeneous parent and compact seed remain supplied. Exact local initial turning-point constraints and approximate nonlinear envelope evolution are distinguished. No shared-wall past, nonspherical or asymptotic stability, abundance or observational confirmation.
